item.title: [6.8] Japan government bond yields fall as global markets steady
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Japanese government bond yields saw a significant drop on Friday, as the 10-year yield fell to levels not recorded since mid-September. Even though the Bank of Japan raised rates recently, inflation in Tokyo is rising, fueling predictions of additional rate hikes.

WHY IT MATTERS

The significant drop in Japanese bond yields despite rising inflation expectations provides important context for global bond market stability and carry trade dynamics.
